name: Polgárdi (Hungary)
description: Three vertical stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:1:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Polgárdi: a crowned blue and yellow shield with a white bird and a crozier, with a helm and grey mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Polgárdi arms with crown, helm and mantling
